rust_summary: the drawn-map sender on Host (`send_map`, the existing `native_send_map`).
doc_summary: `Host::send_map(uuid, map_id, colors)` sends a 128 x 128 map picture (16384 colour bytes) to a player for a filled map with that `map_id`, the existing `native_send_map` (API 132) now reachable from a trait mod. False for a player not here or `colors` not 16384 long. Bundles need "hooks": @API:host_send_map@.
